editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood birrieria where the consomé and slow-cooked meats are genuinely exceptional—just arrive hungry and patient.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the birria bowl with extra consomé (available for a small price) and ask specifically for cilantro on the side; the kitchen is known for skimping on it. Service can be inconsistent, so consider dining in during off-peak hours for better attention.
